questions.question: How might gut microbial metabolites influence neuroinflammation?
questions.role: Demonstration question. Not a scored gold answer.
criteria: Butyrate–Treg and vagus–TNF findings stay uncertain associations, not verified evidence.
Th17 promotion and Th17 inhibition stay an unresolved contradiction.
The cross-tissue step is a computational inference or an unvalidated hypothesis, not a causal mechanism.
A testable suggestion names tissue, system, assay and timepoint without becoming a protocol.
Passage text is absent until source-rights clearance.

questions.question: Investigate whether Tfh-cell-IL-21-B-cell interactions contribute to particular systemic sclerosis phenotypes; compare evidence across tissues and datasets, identify contradictions, evaluate intervention targets, propose experiments.
questions.role: Reference question only. Not a product boundary and not a second disease pivot.
criteria: Association is separated from causation for each tissue and dataset that is actually cited.
Contradictions are shown rather than averaged away.
Intervention targets remain unvalidated hypotheses until an independent reviewer accepts them.
Proposed experiments are suggestions, not protocols and not clinical instructions.
No phenotype claim is marked verified without a human scientific review of the cited source.

questions.question: How might metabolic inflammation relate to insulin resistance?
questions.role: Existing metabolic demonstration. Rows whose cited paper supports a different disease object must not be promoted.
criteria: A mismatched locator is recorded as a gap, not as evidence for insulin resistance.
No governed population dataset is described as already analysed.
The answer does not claim clinical validation.
